The main takeaway from our work is that
deep latent variable models can be extended in a principled way to learn the structure of the latent space, which can improve the quality of the learned generative model.

the dependency structure among latent variables in deep generative models can be learned jointly with the variational parameters and the network weights, and this leads to a more expressive and flexible generative model.
